_comment: Thrash configuration. Copy to config.local.json and edit for your machine. config.local.json is gitignored.
_ramtoggle_comment: Path to the ramtoggle CLI (https://github.com/... your ramtoggle). Set to null to disable ramtoggle lanes entirely.
_web_comment: HTML assets served by the backend. Relative paths resolve against the repo root.
_uzu_proxy_comment: Which lane the /api/uzu-chat SSE proxy forwards to (must match a lane id below).
_idle_unload_comment: OPTIONAL. Auto-unload lanes after they have been idle. enabled defaults to false (no auto-unload); ttl_minutes is idle time before unload; lanes is a list of lane ids, or ["*"] for every lane.
_notifications_comment: OPTIONAL. on_load: notify when a lane finishes loading. on_low_memory: warn when free RAM drops below low_memory_gb.
_ram_guard_comment: OPTIONAL. mode is "warn" (surface the problem, still allow the load) or "block" (refuse loads that would breach the limit).

lanes.label: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (uncensored + vision)

lanes._log_comment: OPTIONAL: per-lane log file. Omit to use the default log location.
